entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A dryad Witherbloom student and tutor, the last of her glade after the Brittleblight, who secretly attempts a forbidden resurrection ritual from a chained tome.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A Silverquill student, son of Dean Lu, serving detention in Detention Bog, who helps Dina fight the creature she creates.

entities.name: Lisette
entities.description: A dean of Witherbloom College who rescued Dina from the blight-struck glade and mentors her.

entities.name: Valentin
entities.description: A huffy dean of Witherbloom College who lets Dina stay at Strixhaven after her failed experiment.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer teaching at Strixhaven as Professor Onyx, who recovers the book of failed resurrection spells and rots it away.

entities.name: Maraff
entities.description: A boastful first-year Quandrix hopeful tutored by Dina, who is made to endure an attercop charm.

entities.name: Tivash
entities.description: A professor whose notes about Maraff Dina reads and whose notebook Dina returns.

entities.name: Dean Lu
entities.description: The vocal, charismatic dean of Silverquill and Killian's father.

entities.name: Lady Ana
entities.description: A strict healing mentor whose life ended in betrayal.

entities.name: Vineclinger
entities.description: A hulking, long-haired, musk-smelling creature that is wounded by the bog creature.

entities.name: Bog creature
entities.description: A newly born wurm-like monster made of swamp matter with an ink-magic heart, created when Dina's ritual is corrupted.

entities.name: Pests
entities.description: A family of wart-ridden creatures who are repositories of magical energy and trust Dina; they are lost in the ritual.

entities.name: Brittleblight
entities.description: A disease that drains color and life from habitats across Arcavios and destroyed Dina's glade.

entities.name: Esis tree
entities.description: A tree with ghostly white feathery leaves required by the ritual, found only as a seedling in Onyx's classroom terrarium.

entities.name: Chained tome
entities.description: A metal-plated book bound by delicate chains holding a mage's failed rituals for life from lifelessness.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of life and death magic, housed in living trees.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The ink-magic college of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The college hosting a party that Dina skips.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university of mages on Arcavios.

entities.name: Widdershins Hall
entities.description: The living-tree main hall of Witherbloom College with labs and an infirmary.

entities.name: Detention Bog
entities.description: A bog where students serve detention and where Dina hides her workshop in the Asenath tree.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's vast archive of magic where Dina found the tome.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven.

events.summary: Dina tutors the arrogant first-year Maraff over tea and he suffers a spider charm.
events.quote: Approximately three and a half minutes later, Maraff was on the ground showing no signs of his earlier braggadocio.

events.summary: Dina visits Deans Lisette and Valentin in their lab, where they work on a crucible.
events.quote: Dina entered the laboratory where the deans of Witherbloom College, Professors Lisette and Valentin, gazed into a crucible being heated by a floating blue flame.

events.summary: Dina declines to attend the Prismari party and says she has work to do.
events.quote: I have work to do.

events.summary: Dina goes to her secret workshop in a hollow tree deep in the bog.
events.quote: It had been one month since she'd first discovered this particular tree, one month since she'd started on her own secret project.

events.summary: Dina recalls finding the tome in the Biblioplex, the meditations of a mage fascinated by life and death (flashback).
events.quote: Part manual, part journal, it captured the meditations of an unnamed mage fascinated by life, death, and the realms locked between them.

events.summary: Dina finds an esis seedling in Professor Onyx's classroom and takes a root sliver for the ritual.
events.quote: Among them was a single seedling whose ghostly white leaves matched that of the esis tree.

events.summary: Dina remembers the Brittleblight destroying her glade and killing its dryads (flashback).
events.quote: When the Brittleblight came for her glade, like it had done for many across Arcavios, few noticed its effects.

events.summary: Dina recalls that Lisette rescued her from the dying glade (flashback).
events.quote: it was she who had arrived at Dina's glade to rescue her before the sickness could take a permanent hold

events.summary: Dina applies her poultice to the pests, asking them to take a short trip for her.
events.quote: I need you to take a short trip for me.

events.summary: Dina traces spirals on the pests and begins reciting the ritual.
events.quote: She placed the spellbook on the ground, and on each pest, she traced a spiral

events.summary: Killian's ink magic cuts a tree and interrupts her concentration.
events.quote: A snap broke her concentration.

events.summary: Killian's wave of ink knocks Dina down before he helps her up.
events.quote: a wave of inky force was rolling toward Dina

events.summary: The corrupted ritual turns the pests into a quivering orb of ink magic, which sprouts tendrils into the ground.
events.quote: But instead of dead pests, sitting on the ground was a jet-black sphere of ink magic quivering as if alive.

events.summary: Dina drags Killian away as the trees wail from the corrupted spell.
events.quote: she took the young man's wrist, pulled as hard as she could, and ran away from the site

events.summary: Dina recognizes Killian as Dean Lu's son and shows him the forbidden tome.
events.quote: Up close, Dina recognized the young man as the son of Dean Lu

events.summary: Returning, they find the pest den destroyed and the pests gone.
events.quote: There were no signs of the pests, and the only remnants of their den were splinters floating on the surface of the creek.

events.summary: Killian explains his detention token and that Silverquill lost the Mage Tower match.
events.quote: I cost my team that point, and Silverquill lost the Mage Tower match.

events.summary: Dina and Killian bond over losing their mothers; Dina's glade is gone.
events.quote: My mother died when I was very young.

events.summary: They find a wounded vineclinger, and Killian saves Dina from its swipe with ink barbs.
events.quote: Acting quickly, Killian pulled her away with one arm

events.summary: Dina sees through the vineclinger's memories the new creature that fought and wounded it.
events.quote: It moved like a great wurm, gouging a path in the soft ground.

events.summary: Dina deduces the creature is headed toward Sedgemoor and is just newly born.
events.quote: Toward Sedgemoor.

events.summary: They find the monster coiled around ancient trees, and Killian proposes breaking the ink-magic heart.
events.quote: If we could just access its heart again, we could break the spell

events.summary: Dina feeds Killian lionspaw leaves so he can see in the dark.
events.quote: Lionspaw has side effects on humans,

events.summary: Dina uses a balancing spell on the creature, making it brittle and slow at great cost to herself.
events.quote: Dina sunk her hand into the dirt a few steps away from the creature and began reciting one of the first spells she learned at Strixhaven.

events.summary: Killian attacks the weakened creature with ink blades and hammers.
events.quote: With Killian's yell came two sickle-shaped blades of pure ink magic slicing into the body of the creature.

events.summary: The creature rakes Killian across the chest.
events.quote: close enough for it to shift its mass and rake him across the chest with a pair of shadowy claws

events.summary: Dina binds Killian with roots, then faces the creature as it crashes down on her.
events.quote: And then, like a great tidal wave, the creature crashed down upon her.

events.summary: In a vision of her glade, a dryad asks whether Dina's lost ones would want to be brought back.
events.quote: And how do you know that they want that?

events.summary: Dina touches the drop of her blood that bound the spell, breaking it.
events.quote: Dina focused on the single drop of her own blood that had bound the spell together.

events.summary: Dina wakes in the Widdershins infirmary and learns Killian dragged her there.
events.quote: The boy is tenacious, dragging you all the way from the bog with a festering wound.

events.summary: Valentin lets Dina stay at Strixhaven as a place of second chances.
events.quote: Strixhaven is a place for new beginnings.

events.summary: Professor Onyx grades exams and recalls her strict mentor Lady Ana.
events.quote: Professor Serafina Onyx blew air at the flame, causing it to dance.

events.summary: Lisette returns the chained tome to Onyx, furious.
events.quote: I believe this is yours

events.summary: Lisette threatens to remove Onyx from the school, and Onyx says it can be arranged.
events.quote: And I'll die before I stop trying to get you as far away from this school as I can.

events.summary: Onyx traces the esis leaf and the tome rots away, leaving only its chains.
events.quote: A black rot spread outward from where she touched it, consuming all the pages in the book, leaving nothing but the chains that had bound them.

relations.note: Lisette brought Dina to Strixhaven and guides her.
relations.quote: Ever since she'd brought Dina to Strixhaven two years ago
I don't need tutoring, and definitely not from another student
the deans of Witherbloom College, Professors Lisette and Valentin
the deans of Witherbloom College, Professors Lisette and Valentin
Up close, Dina recognized the young man as the son of Dean Lu

relations.note: They fight the creature together and call each other friends.

relations.quote: this adversary of her own making

relations.note: Lisette vows to drive Onyx away.
relations.quote: And I'll die before I stop trying to get you as far away from this school as I can.
